narration: The same money, a different life. Your first payslip landed well short of the offer letter, and in month {fork_month} you chose {real_choice} while the ghost took {ghost_choice}. {first_bar_apart} was the first score to part, in that same month. By month {end_month}, the ghost's cushion of reachable money and cover finished {safety_gap}. Its pay also carried fewer claims before each month began, ending {freedom_gap}. The ghost finished with {net_worth_gap}.
